name: estiva-agent
description: Read and act on the Estiva workspace — Ship issues, over a Nostr relay.
long_description:
Gives Claude Desktop tools for the team's Estiva workspace: list and read Ship issues, and — where the credential allows it — comment, set a status, assign, and file an issue.

No signing key is stored on this machine. The extension holds a client credential, exchanges it for a short-lived token, and asks Estiva ID to sign each request. A lost laptop leaks a credential an admin can revoke in one action, not a key.

The identity itself is created by an Estiva ID admin, who also decides what it may sign and admits it to the relay. Entering a credential here does not grant access on its own.

tools.name: ship_list_issues
tools.description: List issues, newest first, with a coverage note saying how much of the workspace the read could reach

tools.name: ship_get_issue
tools.description: One issue in full: description, status, assignee, change history and conversation

tools.name: ship_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to one issue

tools.name: ship_set_status
tools.description: Set the status of one issue

tools.name: ship_assign
tools.description: Assign one issue, by public key

tools.name: ship_create_issue
tools.description: File one new issue in a project

tools.name: estiva_ping
tools.description: Report whether credentials, signing and relay access are working, naming the hop that failed

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: The client id an Estiva ID admin issued for your service identity, e.g. claude-yourname.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: The secret issued alongside the client id. It is shown once, and it is a bearer credential — anyone holding it can read the workspace as that identity until it is revoked. Stored by Claude Desktop, not by this extension.

identity_service.title: Estiva ID service
identity_service.description: The identity service that mints tokens and signs. Leave as it is unless an admin tells you otherwise.

relay_url.title: Relay
relay_url.description: The relay holding the workspace. This is production; there is no staging workspace. Leave as it is unless an admin tells you otherwise.
